{{Quote|Good thing those bugs can't aim.|The Clone trooper, referring to the Geonosians|<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" />}}
A '''[[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]''' was present at the beginning of the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. He joked about how the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] did not aim well while traveling in a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic Gunship]]. Ironically, moments after he said this everyone present in the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] died from a direct hit by the Geonosians.<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone trooper first appeared in "[[Landing at Point Rain]]", the fifth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which premiered on [[November 4]], [[2009]]. The clone trooper was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" />
